description: Talk to Switch's unrestricted operator (the flame in the Studio chat): the mature, uncensored creative brain that runs on BytePlus with its own workspace, tools and skills. Send a brief, a question, a research ask or a coding task; it answers in its own words and, when it wants to spend tokens, write a file or run a command, it pauses and returns pending_action for the creator to allow or deny (decide_switch_unrestricted_action). Keeps its own conversation history: pass back conversation_id to continue. While it is still working, a new message steers it. Nothing here is sent to Claude. Owner-gated: returns NOT_ALLOWED for accounts without the flame.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id from an earlier answer to continue that conversation; omit to start a new one.

message.description: What to say to the operator. Plain words. Name staged Studio references as @Image1 etc.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for words before returning (5 to 55, default 45). If it is still working, call again with the same conversation_id.

name: ask_switch_unrestricted
title: Ask Switch Unrestricted
